article_title: Van Gogh painting sells for record $190.4m after row over its Nazi history
adaptation_summary: Adapted for level A; emphasis on article-specific comprehension, inference, and concise written responses.

tasks.prompt: Why was the sale of Van Gogh's painting especially notable?
options: It set a new auction record for the artist after a dispute over its Nazi-era history was resolved
It was the first Van Gogh painting ever sold
The buyer donated it to a museum before the auction
It was painted during the artist's childhood
tasks.correct_answer: It set a new auction record for the artist after a dispute over its Nazi-era history was resolved
tasks.explanation_hebrew: המכירה הייתה בולטת משום שקבעה שיא חדש לוואן גוך לאחר שהצדדים פתרו מחלוקת על ההיסטוריה של היצירה בתקופה הנאצית.

tasks.prompt: How much did the painting sell for?
When did Van Gogh paint Châtaigniers en fleurs?
options: In 1890, during the final two months of his life
In 1936, after World War Two
tasks.correct_answer: In 1890, during the final two months of his life
tasks.explanation_hebrew: היצירה צוירה בשנת 1890, במהלך החודשיים האחרונים לחייו של ואן גוך.

tasks.prompt: What does “sold under duress” mean in this article?
options: Sold freely at a public celebration
Sold because of pressure or threatening circumstances
Sold without any money changing hands
Sold by an unknown buyer
tasks.correct_answer: Sold because of pressure or threatening circumstances
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הביטוי מתאר מכירה שנעשתה תחת לחץ או נסיבות מאיימות, ולא מתוך בחירה חופשית לחלוטין.

tasks.prompt: Why was the agreement reached just before the auction important?
options: It allowed the sale to proceed despite the ownership-history dispute
It revealed the buyer's identity
It lowered the estimate to zero
It returned the painting to Van Gogh
tasks.correct_answer: It allowed the sale to proceed despite the ownership-history dispute
tasks.explanation_hebrew: ההסכם בין המשפחות פתר את המחלוקת בזמן ואפשר את קיום המכירה.

tasks.prompt: Who owned the painting before the Blaquier family acquired it in 1975?
options: Only Vincent van Gogh himself
A sequence of owners that included the Fischer family and later other owners
The anonymous 2026 buyer
The New York auction house from 1890 onward
tasks.correct_answer: A sequence of owners that included the Fischer family and later other owners
tasks.explanation_hebrew: לפי תיעוד המקור, משפחת פישר החזיקה ביצירה ולאחר מכן היא עברה בין כמה בעלים לפני שנרכשה ב־1975.

tasks.prompt: Explain in 2–3 sentences what the dispute was and how it was resolved.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לציין שיורשי משפחת פישר טענו שהיצירה נמכרה תחת לחץ בתקופת עליית הנאצים, וששתי המשפחות הגיעו להסדר מוסכם שאפשר את המכירה.
expected_points: The Fischer heirs said the painting may have been sold under Nazi-era duress.
They linked the sale to financial losses suffered by the family's publishing company.
The Fischer and Blaquier-Arrieta families reached a mutually satisfactory agreement before the auction.

tasks.prompt: Give two reasons the painting was considered highly valuable.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לציין שני גורמים מן הכתבה: יצירה חשובה מסוף חייו של ואן גוך, נדירותה בידיים פרטיות, השיא הקודם או ההערכה המוקדמת של 180 מיליון דולר.
expected_points: It was painted in the final two months of Van Gogh's life.
Sotheby's described it as one of the most important works from that period still in private hands.

tasks.prompt: Write 3–4 sentences explaining why an artwork's ownership history matters at an auction.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להסביר שמקור הבעלות יכול להשפיע על חוקיות המכירה, צדק כלפי יורשים, אמון הקונים והמוניטין של בית המכירות, תוך קישור למקרה שבכתבה.
expected_points: Provenance shows how an artwork changed hands.
A disputed forced sale may create legal and ethical claims for heirs.
Resolving such claims helps buyers and auction houses trust that a sale can proceed fairly.

tasks.prompt: Summarise the painting's sale, historical dispute and ownership trail in 4–5 sentences.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לכלול את מחיר השיא, מועד יצירת הציור, טענת משפחת פישר, ההסדר והמעבר בין בעלים עד משפחת בלקייר.
expected_points: The 1890 painting sold for a Van Gogh auction record of $190.4m.
The Fischer heirs questioned whether an earlier sale occurred under Nazi-era duress.
The families reached an agreement shortly before the auction.
The work passed through several owners before the Blaquier family acquired it in 1975.
